site.role: Sociology student · Psychology & Philosophy · Content creator
site.bio: I'm a sociology student. I read philosophy and psychology to understand why people behave the way they do, and I write about what I find. On the side I love programming and cybersecurity, and I build small web products when an idea deserves to exist. Everything linked on this site is live and open to inspect.
hero.description: I'm Zaid — a sociology student, a reader of philosophy and psychology, and a writer about both. I write what I learn, and in parallel I build small web products. Two products are live right now, and every claim here links to something you can open.
about.label: About
about.heading: Who I am
about.identity1Detail: I study how societies shape the people inside them — the norms, the roles, and the forces behind ordinary behavior.
about.identity2Detail: Two ways of asking one question: why do we do what we do, and what should we do about it.
about.identity3Detail: I write about this field and publish the short version on social channels — the ideas worth keeping, and the ones I got wrong.
about.body: Alongside the reading and the writing, I love programming and cybersecurity. Some ideas deserve to exist as something you can click, so I build them. Two of those are live below.
